userStories.title: Review ralph.py (848 lines) for line-level bugs
userStories.description:
Current state: ralph.py is the main Ralph autonomous loop engine (848 lines). Read code/ralph.py thoroughly.

Task: Append a bug report to ralph/projects/ralph-self-audit/review.md covering: off-by-one errors, missing None checks, logic errors, error handling gaps, race conditions, hardcoded values, anything that crashes or produces wrong output.

Format: ralph.py:{line} - [BUG] description

Commit: git -C ralph add review.md && git -C ralph commit -m review-ralph-py-audit
